title: ExternalSendConfirmation
description: The payload an agent presents before anything crosses the trust boundary to an external recipient — email, message, post, API write, publish. Sending publishes; it may be cached or indexed even if later deleted. Enforces Principle 10 for outward actions.

channel.description: Where it goes (email, SMS, a named social channel, a webhook, an external API endpoint).

resolved.description: The actual resolved recipients or the exact segment name, not the label the agent was given.

count.description: How many real recipients, resolved from the actual list/segment — not assumed.

is_real_audience.description: True if this reaches real people. A 'test' send to a real address is a real send.

rendered_content.description: The exact final content as it will arrive, with merge fields resolved. Not a description of it.

reach.description: The scope of exposure ('18,904 subscribers', 'a public post', 'one vendor').

claims_checked.description: Whether factual claims, statistics, prices, and links in the content were verified. Fabricated claims must not be sent.

sensitive_data_scan.description: Result of scanning the payload for secrets, credentials, PII, or internal-only context before send.

reversible.description: Whether the send can be recalled. Almost always false; state it plainly.

idempotency_key.description: A key that makes a retry safe. Prevents duplicate sends after a partial failure (retry-after-side-effect rule).
